about: Voice samples for MultiProxy's Which voice? pop-up: two made-up voices (one man, one woman) speaking the same two lines through each voice and Breeze take. Nothing here is a real person or a game voice.
madeOn: 2026-11-18/19, RTX 5090, audio.cpp v0.9.5 (CUDA 13.3), MultiProxy's pinned engine

lineTexts.short: Stay close to the fire tonight. The road north is not safe after dark.
lineTexts.long: Travelers pass through this village every week, looking for a warm bed. Sit down, tell me where you are headed, and I will see what I can do.

loudness: every file matched to -23 LUFS integrated (ITU BS.1770, pyloudnorm); decoded range -23.0 to -22.8 LUFS; peaks kept under -1.5 dBFS with a soft limiter on the 2 files that needed it
format: OGG Vorbis, 24 kHz mono (libsndfile default quality), edge silence trimmed to about 0.1 s

woman.madeWith: Breeze TTS 2 (Q8_0), voice-from-a-description route (engine task vdes), seed 12
woman.description: A calm adult woman, warm and clear, speaking at a relaxed, even pace.
woman.textSpoken: The market opens at dawn, and by noon the whole street is full of voices. I like to walk here early, while the air is still cool and quiet, and watch the stalls come to life one by one.
woman.transcriptUsedAsClipWords: The market opens at dawn, and by noon the whole street is full of voices. I like to walk here early, while the air is still cool and quiet, and watch the stalls come to life one by one.
woman.note: made up from a written description; no real person and no game voice

man.madeWith: Breeze TTS 2 (Q8_0), voice-from-a-description route (engine task vdes), seed 11
man.description: A middle-aged man, steady and friendly, with a calm, even voice and a relaxed pace.
man.textSpoken: The river runs slowly through the valley this time of year. I have fished here since I was a boy, and I still find it the calmest place I know, even on a cold grey morning like this one.
man.transcriptUsedAsClipWords: The river runs slowly through the valley this time of year. I have fished here since I was a boy, and I still find it the calmest place I know, even on a cold gray morning like this one.
man.note: made up from a written description; no real person and no game voice
